Our experience and attention to detail allows us to administer first-class responsiveness to today’s demands while remaining cost-effective. about:
Rowe Electronics operates from Norwalk, Iowa. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its about page describes its origins as "humble beginnings" before becoming a supplier of remote control systems based on microprocessor technology.

The firm provides a range of engineering and manufacturing services centered on wire harnesses, electronic controls, and prototype development. Its capabilities span controls engineering, electronics engineering (including digital, analog, and power design), harness engineering (design, routing, packaging, testing, and delivery), and prototype engineering (concept validation, design reviews, test plans, and on‑site support). Rowe also produces RF systems, wireless throttle controls, and custom manufactured assemblies for mobile equipment and other sectors.

Rowe serves customers in agriculture, transportation, recreation, and industrial markets, with a primary focus on mobile equipment manufacturers. The company works with OEMs on projects ranging from accessory integration to complete machine solutions, and collaborates with client engineering teams on both turnkey and subset developments.

Rowe emphasizes a client‑first process that begins with understanding requirements and scales from small pilot projects to larger engagements. It differentiates itself through deep technical experience across the full electrical architecture, the ability to work within a client’s existing software and supply chain, and a prototyping approach that includes periodic design reviews and on‑site data collection.
